lead: somebody mentioned it at a table once and it held you for about a fortnight. you have been under it for nine years now, and the holding is not what kept you down there.
sun: you went down because the given reason would not carry weight, and the one beneath that would not either, and each floor you took out put another in view. so the descent runs on answers failing rather than on any hunger for the next one — it was never interest holding it open — and nothing ever comes back up to report that the bottom is near.
moon: underneath, finding out is quick and it completes. it had the thing inside a fortnight, was faintly let down by it the way arriving is always faintly disappointing here, and went off after something newer. it has taken no part in the nine years since. that appetite stands fourteen stations off your sun, as far along this road as anything gets before the distance starts closing again.
pull: nine years into something that stopped being interesting in the third week, and no part of you was ever going to be the one that called it off.
tension: love is what the length of it looks like from outside, and people say dedication, admiringly. dedication is a form of wanting, and the wanting went out in the first month — what they are looking at is a search with nobody at the switch. saying you have been bored down there since the second year sounds like a pose put on to be interesting, and the boredom is the truest part of the account.
cost: past three explanations that would have satisfied anyone in the room, you have the mechanism itself, and it survives every objection brought to it. the years belonged to a person who was neither curious nor satisfied. one end of you has no signal to stop and the far end stopped caring in week three, so the finding arrives to nobody, including you.

lead: sixty people went home from the members' meeting knowing what the place had been standing on. somebody had asked you something straight and you answered it. that evening is five years old and still working on them.
sun: the honest answer sat three layers under the one being asked for. you had been beneath the accounts for a year, and what you had was not a complaint about a treasurer, it was the arrangement the whole place had run on since before any of them joined. so what came out of your mouth in that hall was a foundation, described exactly, to the people standing on it.
moon: no private register exists here. the finding could not be walked round to two people first, or given in a size somebody might survive hearing — it went into the room entire, on the night, once. a hall cannot be un-told. what they carry out of it is the arrangement itself, and that will not lie down next to the account they had all been getting by on.
pull: sixty people heard what their place had been resting on, in one evening, at the only size available to you, and the version they walked in with is gone from all of them.
tension: wrecker gets said in car parks rather than to your face, by people who cannot fault a line of it. the accuracy is what makes the charge stick — a wrong answer would have blown over by spring. what you are actually being charged with is the room and the once: it was true, it was heard by everyone simultaneously, it cannot be reduced afterwards, and no smaller version of it was ever in existence to be compared against.
cost: nobody needs a season of meetings to find out what is wrong with a place you are inside. you go under the agreed reason on the first night and come up with what is underneath it, and the same pass that finds it publishes it. that hall got its answer and could not use it. half of them had resigned inside the year, and the answer was correct.

lead: you rang him twelve years after the last conversation and he was glad, and by the second evening you were back under the same thing, as though what happened at the end of it had been an interval.
sun: what finished that friendship was you getting to the bottom of him. the account he ran on did not survive one long night of proper questions, and the marriage built on that account did not survive it either, and you were right about every part of it, and he stopped answering. none of that registered in you as a demolition. it registered as the depth you had reached.
moon: leaving is only the half that comes before coming back, so twelve years of silence read in here as not yet rather than as a verdict. nothing files as gone. and what you return to is the dig — you take it up where it stopped, at the layer under the one that ended it, in a man who spent a decade putting a floor back in.
pull: he had to build the whole thing again out of nothing. you had it stored as a conversation that got interrupted, and you came back to finish it.
tension: for about a month everyone who watched the first round, him included, takes the return for remorse. then a question arrives that only makes sense if his account was never accepted, and the whole descent is live again, and he understands that nothing was ever withdrawn. the warmth is real, and without it no second approach could happen at all, and the second approach is the first one continuing.
cost: you go back. people who have been dismantled by somebody generally never hear from them again, and here you turn up a decade on with genuine fondness, no defensiveness, no performance of having changed. the same instrument comes back with you. the friendship gets a second life and spends it being taken further apart than the first one managed.

lead: four years after the funeral you found the reason. nobody asked you for it, he is not available to confirm it, and the family have a version of him they are living on.
sun: the search did not switch off when he did. the sequence that ended in that room had a cause, and the cause had one under it, and the dead put up no resistance — nobody defending the account, nobody to say this is enough now — so you went further in than could ever have been managed while he was alive to ask. you have the mechanism of his last decade and it is right.
moon: what everyone else has by the fourth year is a soft outline they can love. the dead do not blur down here. yours resolves the harder you look, into detail, and more detail beneath that, and nothing in the looking sets an amount. he is not there to say when enough of you has gone into it, and grief that nobody caps takes whatever is available.
pull: everyone else's dead soften. yours develops. you know more about him now than in the years he was alive to correct it, and there is nobody left to hand any of it to.
tension: at the table they say his name and mean the man in the photograph. what you went down and found is not that man, and it cannot be produced there. saying it aloud would be an act against somebody who cannot answer, so it stays down there and goes on growing, and your quiet at those gatherings gets taken for mourning that never finished. the mourning finished. the excavation is what has been running since.
cost: a death nobody could account for has a full account in you, arrived at four years late, and it holds. what went in the getting there was the bearable version of him. the presentable man came apart first, on the way down, and he was yours before he was anybody's, so everyone at that table still has him, and the man who actually died has been buried by one person.
